sections.heading: Lok's Springer
sections.text:
A Springer Amulet had been discovered by Eathon Lambert and used on his adventures. [Huntik.com] Eathon eventually hid Springer's Amulet in the Paris Catacombs with the intent of it being passed onto his son, Lok Lambert. The Amulet was hidden inside of a square puzzle that triggered a time-based trap, forcing Lok to solve the puzzle. During the time he spent solving it, he unknowingly bonded with Springer. [Crawling the Catacombs] Lok later summoned Springer for the first time to open a locked box inside the Paris Catacombs. [Divide and Conquer]

Lok called on Springer in the Temple of Thor in order to untie the Gleipnir rope so that the Huntik Team could tie up and defeat a wild Fenris. [Two Powers Become One]

Springer was used by Lok in conjunction with several other Titans to create a mechanism to bring a shipwreck they initially suspected was the Argo to the surface. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Lok invoked Springer in the Tomb of Nefertiti in order to activate a release mechanism to deactivate a sand trap Dante Vale was in. Dante invoked Solwing to fly Springer to the mechanism, and he was able to activate it before Dante was smothered by the sand. While in the chamber Dante was trapped in, Springer ended up finding a secret passage Eathon Lambert meant Lok to find. [The Sceptre Deception]

The Titan was called by Lok again to free the Huntik Team from a cage the Amazons put them in. Springer united the ropes Sophie and Cherit were trapped in. [Ladies' Choice]

Springer was invoked by Lok to handle the traps while they were going down the entrance of King Solomon's Mines. Dante and Tersly invoked their Red Searcher Titans to first spot the traps, but no trap was found for Springer to handle. [To Be Together]

In Nostradamus' Tower, Lok called Springer to untie Peter from the rope the Organization tied him with upon raiding the tower. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

During the mission at Klaus' bookshop to recover the Amulet of Void, Springer was able to knock over a bookshelf and find the hidden elevator down to the lab. There, he assisted Lok in accessing the secret locker containing Void's Amulet and also helped to bite through and free the Huntik team from the vines of Dark Dryad. [The Blood Spiral]

Springer's amulet was briefly shown during Lok's dream induced by Arc as all of Lok's amulets were forced out of his bag and turned into Harlekin Titans. [The Legendary Titan of Fate]

Lok invoked Springer once again in the Pyramid of the Sun to search the room he was in. Springer managed to find and press two buttons that unlocked pyrotechnic material, later used by Lok to get access to the Legendary Titan of Summons, Quetzalcoatl. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

At one point, Lok used Springer to deactivate a trap that would have squashed them. [SAS-071]

At another undisclosed moment, Springer was invoked by Lok to sneak behind enemy lines. [LGS-039]

sections.heading: Dante's Springer
sections.wikitext: Another Springer Amulet was in [[Dante Vale]]'s possession when he removed his [[Ignatius]] Amulet from his drawer. {{source|The Legacy of Thor}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
Image caption: Springer saves Dante's life by deactivating a sand trap's mechanism

Springer is a Titan skilled at solving complex puzzles and intricate traps. After he studies the trap and its workings, he is capable of pressing a glowing claw to it, and it magically pops open, deactivates, or harmlessly goes off. [Divide and Conquer] [The Sceptre Deception] This includes even untying complex knots, which he can either do manually by using his claws, [Two Powers Become One] or simply wagging his tail on the knots. [Ladies' Choice] His sharp teeth can be useful for biting through vines and ropes, and his claws allow him to climb virtually any surface. He is also quite quick on his feet [The Blood Spiral] and very perceptive of things such as hidden passages. [The Sceptre Deception] Springer can also be very effective at flanking enemy lines due to his sneaky nature. [LGS-039]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Springer's summoning commands are: "'''Help us out'''", "'''Time to play'''", "'''Let us through'''" and "'''Come out'''".
* Springer's name originates from the verb "spring", which can can mean "to leap, move or act swiftly" or be used to describe the action of a spring or other elastic force. {{Extsource|http://dictionary.com/browse/spring|Dictionary.com}}
* The codeword to unlock Springer at CW4Kids was SPRINGER64.
* Since it is based on the Kitsune from Japanese folklore, Springer should theoretically be a [[:Category:Yama-Titans|Yama-Titan]] rather than a [[:Category:Meso-Titans|Meso-Titan]], who usually have their roots in Native American folklore.
